description: Replication Data for: Nonlinear topology optimization of District Heating Networks: A benchmark of a mixed-integer and a density-based approach is a data set deposited in KU Leuven RDR by its authors Yannick Wack (Associatie KU Leuven). A data-set containing the structure, input parameters and optimization results of the heating networks used in benchmark of the paper "Nonlinear topology optimization of District Heating Networks: A benchmark of a mixed-integer and a density-based approach". This data can be used to replicate the results of the publication. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. Formats: CSV. Size stated: 6775. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
